newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 6.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Court seeks Interpol help to trace pornographic video in Germany which was filmed using children in Beruwela children's home.
Thirty independent groups hand in deposits for nominations in March 27 local government election.
Security forces advance nine kilometers into Tamil Tiger rebel territory in northcentral Wanni region, destroying two abandoned guerrilla camps.
President Chandrika Kumaratunha to head co-ordinating committee set up to promote and develop Sri Lanka's economic interests abroad.

Opposition United National Party parliamentarian, Karunasena Kodituwakku said planning to propose no-faith motion against government for alleged corruption, malpractices and irregularities in privatisation programme.
